note: The polymer class of a fibre (fiber.fiber_type). Values follow the material_bank v0.2 enum (ADR-0004); our wording.

terms.label: cellulose
terms.definition: Plant polymer: cotton, linen and hemp, and the fibres regenerated from wood pulp (viscose, lyocell, modal).

terms.label: protein
terms.definition: Animal fibres: wool and other hair fibres, and silk.

terms.label: polyamide
terms.definition: The nylon family, such as polyamide 6 and polyamide 66.

terms.label: elastane
terms.definition: Segmented polyurethane that stretches several times its length and springs back.

terms.label: other
terms.definition: A known polymer class not listed here.

terms.label: unknown
terms.definition: The polymer class is not known.
